a_startup.description: App start to the build list: boot (data, fonts, Launch, Main:Init), the list of the 7 fixture builds, hover a few rows, idle.

b_open_build.description: Open builds of every archetype (load-build: main:SetMode("BUILD", false, name, xml), the build list's path without the file name; l_save opens one by double-click): the first open in the process is cold (the 3.29 tree's data and sprites, image decodes), the reopen of the same build is warm, then an attack build on an older tree (3.13: another tree loads), a minion build, a DoT build and a build with many items and two item sets.

c_tree_alloc.description: Allocate and deallocate passive tree nodes one after another on a cluster-heavy spell build (allflame_exp_001, Ethereal Knives Elementalist, 27 cluster jewel lines); every click is a spec change and a full recalc, and the hover before it computes the tooltip's stat differences (misc calculator). Ends with undo/redo and a large deallocation (118 dependent nodes) and its undo.

d_tree_navigate.description: Pan, zoom and hover the passive tree of a cluster-heavy build (allflame_exp_001): idle frames, node tooltips with stat differences (allocated and unallocated nodes, a jewel socket), sweeping the cursor over the tree, zooming all the way out and back in, dragging, and searching.

e_items.description: Items tab of a build with many items and two item sets (allflame_exp_005, Smite Luminary, 40 items): hover the equipped slots (item tooltips with stat differences), swap the helmet through its slot dropdown (hovering the candidate first) and back, switch the item set and back, and the weapon swap.

f_skills.description: Skills tab of allflame_exp_001 (Ethereal Knives): select the main socket group, raise and lower a gem level, disable and re-enable a gem, add a support gem by typing its name (the gem list sorted by DPS: one misc calculation per candidate gem) and remove it again, then change the main skill in the sidebar and back.

g_config.description: Configuration tab of upstream_Dual_Wield_Cospris_CoC (Cyclone CoC): hover options (each tooltip runs the misc calculator with the option flipped), toggle player and enemy conditions, type a charge count, and scroll.

h_calcs.description: Calcs tab of an attack build (upstream_Generals_Perforate_Zerker, Perforate/General's Cry): hover cells (their breakdown popups), pin a breakdown by clicking, scroll the sections, and switch the shown socket group (a CALCS-mode recalc).

i_power.description: The node power heat map and the power report: turn on "Show Node Power" on allflame_exp_048 (Flicker Strike) and wait for the report (CalcsTab:BuildPower, resumed once per tree draw, yielding every 100 ms of work), open the power report list, change the character level with the heat map on (a recalc, then the whole report again), then the same heat map on a minion build (allflame_exp_032, Raise Spectre).

j_compare.description: Compare allflame_exp_001 with a second build: open the Compare tab, import the comparison build from a build code (decode, load and recalc it), then the summary, tree, skills, items and calcs comparison views.

k_import.description: Import/Export tab: generate this build's share code (XML, deflate, base64), paste a build code (validated as it is typed), and import it as a new build (decode, load, first recalc).

l_save.description: Open a DoT build (allflame_exp_016, Righteous Fire) from the build list with a double-click, change the character level (a recalc) and save with Ctrl+S (Build:SaveDB, the XML written to the user dir: in memory here), type a note in the Notes tab and save again with the Save button.
